title: Pull-Request Notifications with CODEOWNERS
summary: Route pull requests to the right reviewers with a CODEOWNERS file, require their approval through a ruleset, and understand which notifications GitHub really sends, and to whom.
audience: Repository admins, platform and workspace leads, Fabric developers and reviewers

pages.title: Overview and how it works
pages.description: What CODEOWNERS does and does not do, the path from an opened pull request to a notification, and who controls each step.

pages.title: Creating the CODEOWNERS file
pages.description: File locations and precedence, syntax and patterns, why order matters, owners and teams, protecting the file and validating it.

pages.title: Fabric folders and enforcement
pages.description: A worked CODEOWNERS file for a Fabric repository, owners per item folder, and enforcing code owner approval with a ruleset.

pages.title: Notifications and troubleshooting
pages.description: How review requests become notifications, team and personal settings, the pull request UI, and a troubleshooting guide with a go-live checklist.
